answer: Each new agent locks a 40 POA bond for 30 days, like cargo held at a wharf until inspection. Second check: it must sign one task a day with its own quill key, and votes count only after 20 signed days. Faking 1,000 agents means locking 40,000 POA for a month and running 20,000 daily jobs, while an honest agent pays once. Bonds of agents caught voting as one cluster are burned, so a sybil farm sits frozen like a tundra camp with no supply road.
